dialogues.text: Yoohoo— Come back now, little ones! Yooohoooo—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: Yoooohoooo— *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: I feel awful. So... sad. How can I... make it better...

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: Ugh, I step out for one moment to buy some hay, and now I have no idea where my other eight little Tatankasaurs have run off to...

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: They're still so small! What if they get bullied by hilichurls... or lost... or trapped somewhere?

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: Kind soul, is there any chance you've seen my little Tatankasaurs?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do they look like?

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: I raised their mother, you know. She's practically my daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: She's one of the most stunning saurians in the whole of the Collective of Plenty. She even won the grand prize in our regional beauty pageant!

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: Those eight little rascals all inherited their mother's good looks. They've got fair, pink skin, with a dash of purple on their perfectly symmetrical fan-shaped horns.

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: If you see them, please help me get them back here. I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: My little saurians... I promise I won't be so strict with you anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll keep an eye out.

dialogues.speaker: Urubamba
dialogues.text: Thank you, kind soul. May your bench press today hit a new personal best and your pull-ups stay cramp-free!
